subject: Post-demo MAP + RACI: draft and owner confirmation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finly.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@finly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo MAP + RACI: draft and owner confirmation

Hi Elena / Sam —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for the time. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-Finly-v1.xlsx) summarizing milestones, proposed owners, success criteria, and dependencies. High-level ask: please confirm the owners/responsible parties on the right column and any timing changes so we can lock the timeline next week.

Key highlights / proposed timeline:
- Target close date: 2027-07-08 (proposed)
- Milestone 1: Security review complete — owner: Finly security (TBD). Target: 2027-05-30
- Milestone 2: Procurement SOW & pricing approval — owner: Finly procurement. Target: 2027-06-10
- Milestone 3: POC / onboarding runbook sign-off — owner: Redwood ENG (Karthik). Target: 2027-06-24
- Milestone 4: Contract execution & go-live schedule — owner: Finly legal/procurement + Redwood sales. Target: 2027-07-08

Proposed RACI (high level) — please confirm: 
- Economic buyer: Sam Patel (Finly) — Responsible for sign-off on budget
- Security owner: Elena Rossi (Finly) — Leads SOC2/technical review
- Legal owner: Procurements Finly (procurement@finly.com) — Contract redlines
- Engineering lead: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — POC & onboarding technical lead

Dependencies called out in the sheet: SOC2 evidence, network IP allowlist, and acceptable data retention terms. I attached a short SOC2-summary.pdf to speed review.

Next steps:
1) Elena / Sam — confirm the owners listed above and any timing changes by EOD Friday 2027-05-21
2) If owners differ, please reply with the correct contact and preferred milestone deadline
3) Redwood will update the MAP and re-issue a v2 reflecting confirmed owners and any procurement windows

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite to review the updated MAP once owners are confirmed.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP-Finly-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@finly.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@finly.com>
Cc: Procurements Finly <procurements@finly.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP + RACI: draft and owner confirmation

Thanks Jonas — nice recap. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Confirmed — Sam Patel (cc’d) is the primary budget owner.
- Security owner: I will lead the technical & SOC2 review; my team will need the SOC2 evidence you referenced (scope, controls) and a short runbook for network config.
- Legal / Procurement: looping in Procurements Finly (procurements@finly.com) for contract pace and standard T&Cs — I’ve also attached our procurement intake form (Procurement-terms.docx) for your review.

Timing adjustments we propose based on internal calendar: 
- Security review complete: 2027-06-03 (we need an extra week to align internal reviewers)
- Procurement SOW & pricing approval: 2027-06-17
- POC sign-off: 2027-06-30
- Contract execution & go-live: 2027-07-15

These push the target close about one week later. If Redwood can accelerate the SOC2 evidence delivery and provide an onboarding runbook for Karthik to test the POC quickly, we can keep it tighter.

On owners: I confirm the RACI but will identify a specific security reviewer by next Tuesday (2027-05-25).

Open question for Redwood: Can you share a short list of typical onboarding tasks and an expected time-to-first-token for a POC? That will help our eng lead schedule the work.

Best,
Elena
Director, IT Security | Finly Inc
elena@finly.com

Attachment: Procurement-terms.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo MAP + RACI: draft and owner confirmation

Jonas — good thread. A couple notes from Sales Ops / Legal prep before we update the MAP: 

- Lauren (legal): please note Finly asked for procurement intake form; expect potential redlines around data retention and audit-log access. Can you draft our standard compromise language: 90-day access window for audit logs + customer-managed KMS option?
- Karthik: please prepare a 1-page onboarding runbook (network allowlist, sample request sizes, expected token latency) — this can be a short doc to attach to MAP v2. Aim to have that to me by EOD Monday 2027-05-24 so Elena can distribute to reviewers.
- Pricing note: Neha, please confirm if we can hold the current quote for two extra weeks if Finly needs to push closing to 2027-07-15. We should avoid expiration gaps.

I’ll incorporate Elena’s suggested timeline (moves everything ~1 week) and produce MAP v2 once we have Karthik’s runbook and Lauren’s redline template.

Quick internal ask: Jonas — when you update the MAP, add a short column for "acceptance criteria" per milestone (what counts as success) — makes procurement reviews easier.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
